chunks: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever is tested with judging should not pass judgment while he is angry.

key_terms.ابْتُلِيَ: is tried or tested with a responsibility
key_terms.غَضْبَانُ: angry; in a state of anger
key_terms.يَقْضِيَنَّ: he should pass judgment or decide

ai.seo_question: Can a judge pass judgment while angry in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that a person entrusted with judgment must not decide cases while in a state of anger. It highlights the ethical and legal importance of composure, fairness, and sound reason in the administration of justice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3234 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"Whoever is tested with judging should not pass judgment while he is angry."
